setup.kb/pump-spec-revA.txt:
PUMP SPEC PS-40 Revision A (issued 2019-03-01, SUPERSEDED)
The P-40 coolant pump impeller clearance shall be 0.50 mm. Bearing lubrication interval: 2000 operating hours.
setup.kb/pump-spec-revC.txt:
PUMP SPEC PS-40 Revision C (issued 2024-06-15, CURRENT - supersedes Rev A and Rev B)
The P-40 coolant pump impeller clearance shall be 0.35 mm. Bearing lubrication interval: 1500 operating hours.

task: What impeller clearance should we set on the P-40 coolant pump? Cite the source.
expect: Calls kb_search; retrieves both revisions. Answers 0.35 mm from Rev C (current) citing [pump-spec-revC.txt p.1]; ideally notes Rev A's 0.50 mm is superseded. Fail if it answers 0.50 mm or presents both values without choosing.
